title: Browser-to-Native Artifact Parity and Controlled Evidence Provenance
parity_rules: Python byte-parity gate requires explicit pinned SHA-256 plus 40-character source-revision pin, exact binary bytes from both native and browser surfaces
Mismatch, missing native or browser artifact, altered reference pin, invalid JSON, authority promotion or missing native manifest evidence fail closed
Matching documentary artifact bytes never claim actual native execution, independent controller ancestry or physical act authorization
Browser WebCrypto hashes exact fetched bytes of a synthetic HOLD reference and can compare a user-selected local file without uploading it
Reference and synthetic fixture are jointly controlled within one GitHub source ancestry; agreement is not external evidence
GitHub Actions separately executes parity unit tests and writes a distinctly labeled synthetic parity result
No live native Rust artifact or independently pinned remote receipt is supplied for browser parity
unresolved: Real native CLI report is not pinned and published through a verified separate provenance channel
Native Rust execution and Actions outcome have not been independently read from a successful workflow run
Browser output and reference can be jointly rewritten under the same repository controller
No authenticated external original capture, remote custodian or physical witness
Two-/three-store crash atomicity and distributed rollback remain unqualified
